# Synthetic Cursor fixtures

`transcript.synthetic.jsonl` was written by hand from Cursor's hooks documentation. It was **not**
recorded from a real Cursor run, and Cursor's transcript format is undocumented, so treat it as the
shape `src/sessions/cursor-scanner.ts` accepts, not as evidence of what Cursor writes. Replace it with
a redacted real recording when one exists (see docs/hook-capture.md).
